headlines.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general after weeks of uncertainty
headlines.description: After weeks of uncertainty, Todd Blanche was confirmed as U.S. attorney general early Saturday in a mostly party-line vote.

headlines.title: Hundreds of thousands without water in Puerto Rico
headlines.description: Families and businesses in San Juan, Puerto Rico, and nearby towns now have to make do with whatever water they have on hand amid rolling shutoffs that last for 48 hours at a time. NBC News' George Solis is on the ground.

headlines.title: Senate passes sanctions bill on Russia and Iran named for late Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Senate voted overwhelmingly to pass legislation to impose sanctions against Russia and Iran after months of fits and starts, with the death of Republican Sen.

headlines.title: Sen. Bill Cassidy, a critical Republican holdout, backs Todd Blanche for attorney general
headlines.description: Republican Sens. Lisa Murkowski of Alaska and Susan Collins of Maine said they would oppose Blanche. But Cassidy’s support means he will likely be confirmed.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll appeal decision halting ballroom construction to the Supreme Court
headlines.description: A federal appeals court affirmed a federal judge’s ruling to block construction of the White House ballroom while allowing below-ground construction to move forward.

headlines.title: U.S. loses jobs while unemployment rate drops
headlines.description: A jobs report came in weaker than expected as stocks hit a record high. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Video shows hippo charging boat full of tourists in Botswana
headlines.description: Video captured by a tourist on board a boat in northern Botswana showed the heart-pounding moment the vessel had to outrun a charging hippo.

headlines.title: Psychiatrists who treated Lindsay Clancy testify at murder trial
headlines.description: The trial of a mother accused of killing her three children has wrapped its second week. Two psychiatrists who treated Lindsay Clancy before her children's death testified in court today. NBC News' Steven Romo and legal analyst Misty Marris break down the doctors' testimony.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Senate passes short-term bill to prevent a shutdown before the midterm elections
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Senate voted 90-6 early Saturday to pass a short-term funding bill to remove the threat of a government shutdown before the midterm elections.
